Each item's stated OBSERVATION reproduced from the CITED RECORD's verbatim output before any fix; each new gate/classifier calibrated TWO-SIDED against the live corpus; one commit per item with the full suites between.

ITEM 2: fndiff pool_row_findings over all 257 built unit pairs -- POOL-KIND-EQUAL 3,317 rows in 634 functions now pass (they reach into the 100%-matched SDK: DEMOInit::LoadMemInfo is byte-identical at real 0), WRONG-POOL-VALUE 81 rows in 32 functions still fail but with a VALUE reason, POOL-KIND-UNDECIDED 0, and RENAME 81 / WRONG-POOL-DATUM 36 / POOL-RENUMBER 24 untouched. ITEM 3: over all 168 unit pairs the gate can price, 91 units / 134 sections DISAGREE between the two accountings (30,920 bytes of matched Data overstated; sounds_evt 2,173 -> 0, action 2,340 -> 220, player 1,386 -> 0) and 77 units / 326 sections are identical; validated against report.json over the 129 units whose section set the gate covers -- 110 reproduce matched_data EXACTLY, 18 UNDER-count (objdiff credits per symbol and resolves relocations), 1 OVER-counts by 16 bytes (Runtime.PPCEABI.H/NMWException), so it is a LOWER BOUND and that is the safe direction. ITEM 4: over 2,883 comparable function pairs (115 count-asymmetric), 16 functions had a RECOLOR class line while carrying words no register assignment reaches, 99 stay RECOLOR, 162 stay SCHEDULE-REORDER, 2,606 print nothing. ITEM 5: 11 clean-tree first probes across 11 units all CREATED a baseline, 0 refusals; the edited tree refused and --force-baseline created it. ITEM 6: three discriminants swept over 17,688 live-range rows -- A tie-at-the-minimum 3 rows, B distance-0-decisive 98 rows in 52 functions (SHIPPED), C any-window-disagreement 389 rows and REFUTED. ITEM 7: 8 of 52 webfrank blocks resolve through their own unit, 44 file-level. ITEM 8: 183 of 2,034 records carry a hypothesis and only 32 (17.5%) state a count consequence, so a refusal would reject 151 -- shipped as a WARNING. ITEM 9: over all 256 src units, 11 (4.3%) contradicted between the prose headline and the decidable verdict and 245 agreed.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Run the symbol-level rule with fndiff's `_datum_prefix_equal` and `is_pointer_table` applied on dolphin/os/OSContext (gate 0, report 472) and dolphin/gx/GXAttr (gate 284, report 300). If either still under-counts, the gap is not the naming/relocation pair and the lower-bound framing is the right permanent answer.
hypothesis.count_consequence: count-neutral by construction: this is a DATA accounting question and touches no instruction stream. No .text byte moves, so every instruction count on both sides is unchanged and the postprocessor-class question is untouched.
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- this is an accounting question against report.json, not against target bytes; the section rule was validated against report.json's matched_data over 129 units and the 19 disagreements were read individually.
hypothesis.statement: Item 3's all-or-nothing DATA accounting is a LOWER BOUND on the image's Data measure, not a reproduction of it: 18 of 129 covered units under-count report.json because objdiff credits data at SYMBOL granularity and RESOLVES RELOCATIONS, so a section holding a pointer table is credited there while its raw bytes differ here. A symbol-level rule over fndiff.object_datum_table was measured and is WORSE (105 of 129 exact against the section rule's 110), because dtk's target symbol names (lbl_/jumptable_) do not correspond to ours (@N) and relocation-filled tables read as zeros in our object. The next lane on this should pair the two objects' data symbols the way fndiff's datum screen already pairs pool entries -- by VALUE with the prefix rule, and with is_pointer_table excluded -- and check whether that closes the 18.
